title: 4h EMA20 reclaim pullback continuation conditional on BULL_LOW / BEAR_LOW
hypothesis: In established low-volatility directional contexts, a completed 4h candle that reclaims EMA20 in the direction of EMA50/slope10 trend after the prior candle closed on the other side may provide continuation edge versus a fixed ATR stop/target.

falsifiable_conditions.long: context=BULL_LOW; low<=EMA20; close>EMA20; prior close<=prior EMA20
falsifiable_conditions.short: context=BEAR_LOW; high>=EMA20; close<EMA20; prior close>=prior EMA20
falsifiable_conditions.stop: 1.5 x signal-bar Wilder ATR14 from entry
falsifiable_conditions.collision: if stop and target both touch in one bar, assume stop first
falsifiable_conditions.gap: stop gaps fill at bar open; target limit fills at target
falsifiable_conditions.concurrency: one position per symbol; no same-bar re-entry
falsifiable_conditions.direction: long in BULL_LOW, short in BEAR_LOW

context.trend: close>EMA50 and EMA50[t]/EMA50[t-10]-1>0 => BULL; inverse => BEAR; else TRANSITION
context.volatility: Wilder ATR14/close with per-symbol q33/q67 thresholds from training-only context taxonomy artifact

cost_model.description: Exploratory proxy only. Actual fee tier, historical spread/slippage, latency, impact and funding cashflows unavailable. Results cannot qualify as valid OOS evidence.

sizing: normalized 10,000 USDT notional for quote PnL; R normalized by 1.5 ATR stop distance; no leverage recommendation
oos_policy: Do not evaluate final test in this run. Reserve it untouched until realistic cost model, purge/embargo, and generic Node harness validation are available.

bootstrap.method: circular moving-block bootstrap of trade-level net R
